title: 第1933章 伪装如雪落层层剥尽真容似月出历历分明第1932章 九重合拢魔头将灭万里之外清漪惊心
slug: 玄幻长生神子何须妹骨证道
content_zh:
推荐各位书友阅读：玄幻：长生神子，何须妹骨证道！第一卷：默认第1933章伪装如雪落层层剥尽，真容似月出历历分明！（..la）然而盗天魔尊刚刚冲入第一重天罗阵的范围……
一座由赤红色法则凝聚而成的万丈大山从虚空中猛地砸落。
轰！
盗天魔尊整个人被那座大山砸得如同断线的风筝般倒飞出去。
口中喷出一大口暗金色的血线。
身体在虚空中翻滚了数十圈才堪堪稳住身形。
他的九道蛊虫虚影在那股冲击下碎裂了三道。
剩余六道也在疯狂闪烁着明灭不定的光芒。
“……极乐界域的五指山？！”
他猛地抬头看向虚空深处。
“妈的！死秃驴！”
蛊道很少有被克制的，但佛门因果法则偏偏能镇压万蛊。
尤其是这种以愿力凝聚的因果大山，偏偏还带着无量功德金光，硬撼不得。
只见一道模糊的赤红色身影正悬浮在第九重天罗阵的边缘。
如同一尊被凝固在虚空中的巨大雕像。
那双紧闭的眼睛散发着让人从骨髓深处感到战栗的冷漠。
“阿弥陀佛，贫僧此举，是为苍生除害，施主莫要执迷不悟。”
盗天魔尊擦掉嘴角的血迹。
那双桃花眼中翻涌着极度的不甘与恼怒。
“悟你妈个头！谁拦我回家，我就砍死谁！”

而在更远处，方圆和白凝冰同样在朝着战场中心疯狂冲刺。
两人的身形在虚空中如同两道被拉长的流光。
蛊虫虚影在周身飞速旋转着抵挡着那股铺天盖地的法则压迫。
但他们的境界实在太低了。
七转蛊仙在九重天罗阵面前，如同蝼蚁般连第一重阵法的外围都突破不了。
他们刚刚接近第一重天罗阵的边缘便被那股庞大的法则之力硬生生弹了回来。
如同撞上了一堵无形的墙壁。
“该死！”
方圆咬着牙，双掌猛地拍在那堵无形的法则屏障上。
暗金色的蛊虫纹路在掌心中疯狂流转着试图撕裂一道缝隙。
但那屏障如同被浇筑了星辰之铁般纹丝不动。
白凝冰站在他身侧，寒冰长剑已经出鞘了。
冰蓝色的剑气在虚空中划出一道凌厉的弧线。
落在屏障上却只溅起一丝几乎看不见的涟漪。
“打不破。”
content_en:
Recommended reading for all book friends: Fantasy: Why does the Son of the Immortal God need a sister’s bones to prove the truth! Volume 1: Default Chapter 1933 The disguise is peeled off like snow, and the true appearance is as clear as the moonrise! (..la) However, the Heaven-stealing Demon Lord just broke into the range of the first-level Tianluo Formation...
A huge mountain condensed by crimson laws crashed down from the void.
boom!
The Heaven Thieving Demon Lord was hit by the mountain and flew backwards like a kite with its string broken.
A large mouthful of dark golden blood spurted out from his mouth.
His body rolled dozens of times in the void before he could stabilize his body.
Three of his nine Gu insect shadows shattered under the impact.
The remaining six paths are also flashing with uncertain light.
"...Five Finger Mountain in the Paradise Realm?!"
He suddenly raised his head and looked into the depths of the void.
"Damn it! What a bald ass!"
The way of Gu can rarely be restrained, but the Buddhist law of cause and effect can suppress all kinds of Gu.
Especially this kind of mountain of cause and effect condensed by the power of wishes, but it also carries the golden light of immeasurable merit and virtue, which cannot be shaken.
I saw a blurry red figure floating on the edge of the ninth-level Tianluo Formation.
Like a huge statue frozen in the void.
Those tightly closed eyes exuded an indifference that made people tremble from the depths of their bones.
"Amitabha, this poor monk is doing this to eliminate harm to the common people. The donor should not be obsessed with it."
The Thieving Demon Lord wiped the blood from the corner of his mouth.
Those peach blossom eyes were filled with extreme unwillingness and anger.
"Wu, your mother's head! Whoever stops me from going home, I will chop to death!"
Farther away, Fangyuan and Bai Ningbing were also sprinting towards the center of the battlefield.
Their figures were like two elongated streams of light in the void.
The ghost shadow of the Gu insect rotated rapidly around it to resist the overwhelming pressure of the law.
But their level is too low.
The seventh-level Gu Immortal was like an ant in front of the ninth-level Tianluo Formation, unable to even break through the perimeter of the first-level formation.
As soon as they approached the edge of the first level of Tianluo Formation, they were forcefully bounced back by the huge power of law.
It was like hitting an invisible wall.
"Damn it!"
Fang Yuan gritted his teeth and slammed his palms against the invisible law barrier.
The dark golden Gu insect lines were flowing crazily in the palm of the hand, trying to tear open a gap.
But the barrier remained motionless as if it had been poured with iron from the stars.
Bai Ningbing stood beside him, the ice sword already unsheathed.
The ice blue sword energy drew a sharp arc in the void.
Landing on the barrier only caused an almost invisible ripple.
"Can't be broken."
